conventions.timezone: Store timestamps as timestamptz (UTC). Normalize period_start at org tz then convert to UTC.
conventions.naming: snake_case for columns; *_id for FK columns; created_at/updated_at on mutable tables.
conventions.tenant_context: SET LOCAL app.organization_id = '<uuid>' per transaction; RLS on all multi-tenant tables.

policies.name: ingest_item_tenant
policies.using: ingest_batch_id in (select id from ingest_batch where organization_id = current_setting('app.organization_id')::uuid)

views.name: indicator_value_latest
views.definition_note: Select distinct on (org, indicator, period_start_utc, segment_hash) ordered by version desc.

views.name: indicator_target_join
views.definition_note: Join latest values with targets and compute status by direction/tolerance.

views.name: indicator_staleness
views.definition_note: Compute days since last version per indicator to support staleness alerts.

notes: Define GUC per transaction in API and workers.
All multi-tenant tables have USING and WITH CHECK policies.
Avoid SECURITY DEFINER functions that bypass RLS unless strictly validated.
